customStructureDefinitions.name: Pivot Table
customStructureDefinitions.description: Defines the layout of a pivot table over a dataflow. Instances of this definition have the URN class urn:sdmx:org.sdmx.infomodel.csd.imf.PivotTable.

descriptions.en: Defines the layout of a pivot table over a dataflow. Instances of this definition have the URN class urn:sdmx:org.sdmx.infomodel.csd.imf.PivotTable.

properties.description: The dataflow whose data the pivot table lays out. Mandatory (minOccurs defaults to 1).

customTypes.name: Row or Column
customTypes.description: A row or column of the pivot table, bound to a dimension of the dataflow. As a nameable type, instances of this type have an id, a name, and a generated URN using the PivotTableRow class.

descriptions.en: A row or column of the pivot table, bound to a dimension of the dataflow. As a nameable type, instances of this type have an id, a name, and a generated URN using the PivotTableRow class.

properties.description: The identifier of the dimension this row or column is bound to. An indirect reference: the identifier is resolved against the dataflow referenced by the 'dataflow' property of the pivot table.

customTypes.name: Slice
customTypes.description: A slice of the pivot table. Extends RowColType, inheriting its properties, and adds a fixed position. Declares its own class name so that generated URNs remain unique.

descriptions.en: A slice of the pivot table. Extends RowColType, inheriting its properties, and adds a fixed position. Declares its own class name so that generated URNs remain unique.
